title: Worship As Worldly Happiness First Aspect Needs Justice Sharia Prophethood And Belief

questions.question: What makes people different from other living things in this passage?
questions.answer: People have a special nature and can choose.

questions.question: What kinds of things do people naturally want?
questions.answer: They want good things, beauty, and a fitting way to live.

questions.question: Why can a person not get everything ready by himself?
questions.answer: One person cannot do all the jobs and skills alone.

questions.question: What do people need to do with one another?
questions.answer: They need to live together, help each other, and trade their work.

questions.question: Which three human powers are named?
questions.answer: Desire, anger, and thinking.

questions.question: What problem happens when these powers have no set limit?
questions.answer: People can become unfair and hurt others.

questions.question: Why does the community need justice?
questions.answer: People share and trade things, so they need fairness.

questions.question: Why is one person’s mind not enough to make full justice?
questions.answer: One person cannot fully understand justice by himself.

questions.question: What is needed for everyone to benefit from justice?
questions.answer: A law for all people is needed.

questions.question: What does the passage call that law?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Who is needed to bring and announce that law?
questions.answer: A Prophet is needed.

questions.question: What kind of person must a Prophet be?
questions.answer: He must be excellent in character, spirit, actions, and appearance.

questions.question: What shows that the Prophet truly has a strong link with Allah?
questions.answer: His miracles.

questions.question: What helps people obey commands and stay away from what is forbidden?
questions.answer: Remembering Allah’s greatness and believing in Him.

questions.question: What keeps belief strong in people’s minds?
questions.answer: A repeated reminder, which is worship.

questions.question: How does worship help at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: It keeps belief firm and reminds people again and again.

questions.question: What special gift in people is talked about first?
questions.answer: The ability to choose.

questions.question: Besides choosing, what else do people wish for?
questions.answer: Nice things, beauty, food, clothing, and a good place to live.

questions.question: Why do many skills and jobs become necessary?
questions.answer: People need many things prepared well for their lives.

questions.question: What must people do because they need many different skills?
questions.answer: They must work together with others.

questions.question: What happens when human desires and other powers are not naturally kept within limits?
questions.answer: Wrongdoing and pushing against others can happen.

questions.question: What does the passage say society needs when people exchange the results of their work?
questions.answer: It needs justice.

questions.question: Why does humanity need a greater guide than just single people’s minds?
questions.answer: Single minds are too weak to fully grasp justice.

questions.question: What serves as that greater guide for justice?
questions.answer: A universal law.

questions.question: What name is given to this universal law?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Why is a lawgiver needed after the law is mentioned?
questions.answer: Someone must bring it, teach it, and make it known.

questions.question: Who is that lawgiver in the passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Why must the Prophet stand out among people?
questions.answer: So hearts and minds will keep accepting his guidance.

questions.question: What proof is given for the Prophet’s true mission?
questions.answer: Miracles.

questions.question: What must stay alive in people so they will obey and avoid sin?
questions.answer: The greatness of the Creator and the truths of belief.

questions.question: What is the ongoing action that renews that reminder?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: If you had to tell the main idea of this passage in one short sentence, what would it be?
questions.answer: Worship helps keep belief and right living strong.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is unusual about human nature?
questions.answer: It is fine and special compared with other living things.

questions.question: What does this special nature lead people to seek?
questions.answer: It leads them to seek good and beautiful things and a worthy life.

questions.question: Name one area of life where people need help from others.
questions.answer: Food, clothing, or housing.

questions.question: Why do people join with others in daily life?
questions.answer: They need one another’s skills and work.

questions.question: Which human power helps with understanding?
questions.answer: Intellect, or the mind.

questions.question: Which two other powers are mentioned with intellect?
questions.answer: Desire and anger.

questions.question: What bad result can come when these powers go too far?
questions.answer: Oppression and harmful behavior.

questions.question: When people trade the results of their work, what keeps things right?
questions.answer: Justice.

questions.question: Why can’t each person just decide justice fully on his own?
questions.answer: Human minds alone are not enough for that.

questions.question: What is the shared guide for justice called?
questions.answer: The universal law.

questions.question: In this passage, what is that law identified as?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: What role does the Prophet have with that law?
questions.answer: He brings it, declares it, and has authority for it.

questions.question: What kind of qualities should the Prophet have?
questions.answer: Excellent morals, strong spirit, and noble character.

questions.question: What is the sign that supports the Prophet’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: Miracles.

questions.question: What must be shown in people’s hearts so they follow commands and avoid what is forbidden?
questions.answer: The greatness of Allah and the truths of belief.

questions.question: Why is worship needed again and again?
questions.answer: It keeps the reminder fresh and belief steady.

questions.question: What does the passage say about humans compared with animals and other living beings?
questions.answer: Humans are set apart by a special nature.

questions.question: What choice-related quality is given to humans?
questions.answer: They can choose.

questions.question: What does that lead humans to want in life?
questions.answer: Good things, beauty, and a life suitable for them.

questions.question: Why are many crafts and jobs important for people?
questions.answer: People need many things made and prepared well.

questions.question: Can one person master all those crafts alone?
questions.answer: No, one person needs others.

questions.question: What are people supposed to do together?
questions.answer: Help one another and share the results of their work.

questions.question: What human powers are said to have no built-in limits?
questions.answer: Desire, anger, and intellect.

questions.question: What can happen because there are no built-in limits?
questions.answer: People may become unjust and attack others’ rights.

questions.question: What is needed in society because of this danger?
questions.answer: Justice is needed.

questions.question: Why does the passage point to a law for everyone instead of just private opinions?
questions.answer: Private opinions are not enough to fully understand justice.

questions.question: What is the name of the law that gives this justice?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Who must bring and announce this law?
questions.answer: A Prophet.

questions.question: Why must the Prophet be outstanding in many ways?
questions.answer: So his rule in hearts and minds can continue.

questions.question: What proves his connection to the Lord of all?
questions.answer: His miracles.

questions.question: What two things need to stay strong so people obey the law?
questions.answer: Awareness of Allah’s greatness and the truths of belief.

questions.question: What repeated act keeps these truths alive in people?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: What kind of nature do humans have in this passage?
questions.answer: A special and delicate nature.

questions.question: What does this nature make humans want besides basic needs?
questions.answer: Beauty, decoration, and a good place in life.

questions.question: Why do humans need many arts and skills?
questions.answer: To prepare the things they need for living.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about working alone?
questions.answer: Working alone is not enough for human needs.

questions.question: What should people do instead of trying to do everything alone?
questions.answer: They should cooperate and exchange what they produce.

questions.question: What three inner powers are named in the passage?
questions.answer: Appetite or desire, anger, and intellect.

questions.question: What trouble comes when these powers are not limited?
questions.answer: Aggression and wrongdoing appear.

questions.question: What does fair exchange in a community require?
questions.answer: It requires justice.

questions.question: Why is a broad law needed for justice?
questions.answer: Because individual minds cannot fully measure it.

questions.question: What is the broad law called here?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Why is a Prophet needed after that?
questions.answer: To establish, teach, and proclaim the law.

questions.question: What must be true about the Prophet’s character?
questions.answer: It must be higher and better than others.

questions.question: What confirms that the Prophet truly comes from Allah?
questions.answer: Miracles confirm it.

questions.question: What helps people follow commands and stay away from forbidden things?
questions.answer: Keeping Allah’s greatness before them.

questions.question: What else must be fixed firmly in people’s minds?
questions.answer: The beliefs of the faith.

questions.question: According to the last line, what is the repeated reminder that does this?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: What is one main way humans are different in this passage?
questions.answer: They have a unique nature with free choice.

questions.question: What kinds of wishes come from that human nature?
questions.answer: Wanting good, beautiful, and fitting things.

questions.question: Why does human life need many workers and skills?
questions.answer: Because people need many things made well for daily life.

questions.question: What does this show about human life with other people?
questions.answer: Human life depends on cooperation.

questions.question: What three powers in people are mentioned by name?
questions.answer: Desire, anger, and intellect.

questions.question: What may happen if those powers are not controlled?
questions.answer: People may act harshly and unfairly.

questions.question: What does society need so people can share work fairly?
questions.answer: Justice.

questions.question: Why can’t justice depend only on each person’s own thinking?
questions.answer: Each person’s thinking is too limited.

questions.question: What is the shared rule that gives justice to all?
questions.answer: A universal law.

questions.question: What is that universal law called in this passage?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Why is someone with authority needed for the law?
questions.answer: The law needs to be brought, declared, and upheld.

questions.question: Who is that person?
questions.answer: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What must the Prophet be like on the outside and inside?
questions.answer: He must be superior in body, spirit, manners, and character.

questions.question: What special sign supports the Prophet’s truth?
questions.answer: His miracles.

questions.question: What idea must stay strong so people obey and avoid wrong?
questions.answer: The greatness of the Maker.

questions.question: What joins that idea to people again and again?
questions.answer: Worship renews it and keeps belief firm.
